decisions.decision: Create an Organization Settings section and move billing, roles, SAML, and audit logs under it.

reasoning.claim: It matches where the product is going.

source.speaker: Leo Park
source.quote: That is more work, but it matches where the product is going. Billing-only shortcut saves maybe 3 days and creates another cleanup project.

source.speaker: Sarah Kim
source.quote: That would solve the demo issue. Also lol at 'first pass boring' — honestly that's all we need.

reasoning.claim: The billing-only shortcut would create another cleanup project.

objections.claim: There is concern about slipping the admin beta.

source.speaker: Maya Chen
source.quote: My only worry is slipping the admin beta. We promised it to design partners before 2026-08-05.

tradeoffs.claim: The plan accepts a basic IA now instead of doing the full permissions model is the accepted tradeoff.

source.speaker: Leo Park
source.quote: Agree. Tradeoff is we accept a basic IA now instead of doing the full permissions model. Safer than hiding SAML under billing.

timelines.claim: The new section can be wired by next Friday.

source.speaker: Priya Shah
source.quote: If we keep the first pass boring, I can have the new section wired by next Friday. No custom permissions redesign, just navigation plus moving the existing pages.
